utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It starts this Saturday at the front porch, and we’re collecting small repair items and basic tools. I’d love any help spreading the word or setting up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — I can help spread the word and set up at the front porch on Saturday. I’ll bring my drill and a couple of screwdrivers too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Sam — that’s a huge help. We’re starting at the front porch Saturday morning, and I really appreciate you bringing the drill and screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — please pass my name along too, and I’ll keep an ear out for any updates on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll pass it along and let you know if I hear anything new while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. I’ll keep an ear out too and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve been hearing it’s drawing a pretty good crowd. If anything else needs spreading around, I can help pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, that’d be helpful. Do you know what items they’re still collecting for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not sure on the exact list, but I’ve heard they’re still taking common repair items and supplies. If I hear anything more specific, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I can spare a bit of time, just nothing too heavy.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, Uli — I’ll keep it light too. I’m running a bit late as usual, but I’ll come by and help with the repair drive plans.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No problem, Dane. Just come by when you can — I’ll keep the plans simple.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday at 9 works for me. What items are they collecting for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not totally sure yet—can you confirm what’s already covered? What items are still needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m not sure what’s already covered either—let’s just find out what they still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—what kind of repairs are we focusing on for the drive? I can bring over some tools if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Mostly small stuff—loose hinges, squeaky doors, and quick fixes. If you’ve got a basic toolkit, bring that and we’ll be good.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll bring my basic toolkit over for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — mostly small fixes like loose hinges, squeaky doors, and basic patching. If you can help sort tools or greet folks on Saturday, that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve already been spreading the word, so I can pass your name along and help greet folks on Saturday too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — that helps a lot. I’ll set out the tools and be ready on Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help Saturday at the front porch. What should I bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s actually been moved to Sunday at the community center. If you want to help, just bring your tools and I’ll keep track of the details.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it—Sunday at the community center. I’ll bring my tools and help out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sounds good — I’m waiting on the exact details, and then I’ll pass them along right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Pia — the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center. Once I send the exact list, please share it with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Got it — once you send the list, I’ll share the Sunday details with everyone right away.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll pass along the repair drive details and invite to the others right away.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate it. I’m a bit foggy today, so I may miss a detail or two.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive plans. You just take it easy today.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you already have the main list, or should I ask Gus what tools they still need?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the list ready, but if Gus knows what’s still missing, that’d help me update it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ll ask Gus what’s still missing and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess—do you know the start date yet, and who’s organizing the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I still haven’t heard the start date or who’s organizing it yet, but I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess—please let me know as soon as you hear the start date and who’s organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll pass along the repair drive details and repeat the plans to the others right away.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks. I’m still available Saturday at the front porch—just tell me what to bring or fix.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Leo — I’ll tell the others you’re set for Saturday at the front porch and ask them to bring whatever tools or supplies they can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m not sure yet, Noah, but I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Oren — I appreciate it. If you hear the date or who’s organizing the repair drive, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, Noah — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear the date or who’s organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right — the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m bringing my drill and a couple screwdrivers, and I should be there around 10. If you can, just bring whatever parts or tools you’ve already got.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll bring whatever tools and parts I’ve got. See you around 10 on the porch.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules. What date does the repair drive start, and who’s organizing it?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It starts this Saturday, and I’m organizing it from my front porch. We’re mainly collecting broken household items and any basic tools you can spare.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules. Besides the broken household items and basic tools, is there anything else you want people to bring?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve been hearing it’s getting a pretty good turnout. If you want, I can help spread the word a bit more around the block.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Nell — that would help a lot. It’s this Saturday at the front porch, and I’m organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure thing — I’ll pass that along around the block, and this Saturday at the front porch is what I’ll tell folks.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal, sorry I’m late again — I’m here to help with the repair drive plans. Just let me know what still needs covering.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Dane — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. I can use help spreading that update, and I’m keeping track of anyone who still needs location details.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll help spread the word that it’s Sunday at the community center. If anyone’s missing the location details, send them my way too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m keeping a note on what’s still needed for the repair drive. If you tell me what’s already covered, I can fill in the rest.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday at 9 works for me. Do you want the location details?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, please — send me the location details and I’ll add them to my note.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring over the hammer, screwdrivers, pliers, and tape measure this afternoon for the repair drive. Just let me know if you need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus—that should cover it nicely. If you can also bring a ladder if you have one, that’d be a big help for the fence and porch steps.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got a ladder I can bring along too. I’ll have everything over this afternoon for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll come by Sunday and help with something simple.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect, Uli—simple is great. We’ll meet Sunday at the community center, and I’ll let you know one easy thing to take care of.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. Sunday at the community center works for me.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you know what they still need most for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not totally sure yet — I’d want the exact list and drop-off details before I tell anyone. Could you confirm the time and where things should go?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ll check the time and drop-off details and get back to you. Do you know if they’re still asking for tools, or something else?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s already picking up nicely—mostly donations and volunteers this week. I’ll let you know if I hear what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, good to hear. Can you confirm what’s still missing, if anything?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I don’t know the exact gaps yet, but I’ll keep an ear out and tell you if I hear what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard it’s picking up nicely, and I’ll keep an ear out for any updates while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m not sure yet, but I can check what’s already covered and get back to you. What items are still needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can keep an ear out for that while I’m running errands. Let me know what you still need, and I’ll pass it along.
